# API Contracts Checklist: Product Line B Onboarding Smoke

**Purpose**: Validate SPEC-010B API and evidence contract requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-06-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Seed CLI Result Envelope

- [ ] CHK001 Are required seed CLI envelope fields defined for every `preflight`, `apply`, and `verify` mode outcome? [Completeness, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Required Result Envelope]
- [ ] CHK002 Are success statuses, mutation statuses, and typed failure statuses fully enumerated for Product Line B disabled-state, sync-owner, residue, and flag failures? [Completeness, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Required Status And Code Matrix]
- [ ] CHK003 Is no-mutation proof specified with comparable before/after hashes for non-mutating seed modes? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Product Line B Assertions]
- [ ] CHK004 Is `product-line-b` identity required in both config and target fields so Product Line A cannot be mistaken for the smoke target? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Required Result Envelope]

## Error And Conflict Evidence

- [ ] CHK005 Are `errors[]` and `evidence.residue[]` object shapes specified with required redaction-safe fields and forbidden raw secret or raw upstream response fields? [Completeness, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Error And Residue Object Shapes]
- [ ] CHK006 Are seed preflight conflict categories aligned with Product Line B residue, `plb-platform-*` assignment conflicts, repo sync ownership, retained FocusEngine/OpenClaw inventory, and workflow-template ownership conflicts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Failure Codes]
- [ ] CHK007 Are optional live GitHub credential, permission, and mutation-boundary failures represented as skipped/not-mutated evidence instead of required smoke failures? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications §Synthetic Smoke And Evidence, Contract `smoke-evidence.md` §Optional Live Issue Status]
- [ ] CHK008 Is redaction proof objectively measurable for token values, authorization headers, API keys, credentials, raw GitHub responses, and matched secret substrings? [Measurability, Spec §FR-014, Contract `smoke-evidence.md` §Optional Live Issue Status]

## Scoped API Read Models

- [ ] CHK009 Are existing scoped API routes named with the Product Line A and Product Line B workspace-scope requirements they must prove? [Completeness, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §API Evidence]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the read-model fields or response paths required from `/api/status?action=dashboard`, `/api/projects`, `/api/tasks`, `/api/agents`, and `/api/github/sync` specified enough to make scope assertions objective? [Measurability, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §API Evidence]
- [ ] CHK011 Are Product Line A before/after comparisons scoped to Product Line A-owned surfaces instead of whole-database counts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §SQL Evidence]
- [ ] CHK012 Are Product Line B disabled states explicitly inspectable through seed verify, SQL/API/status evidence, and temporary smoke-enabled scope without adding an include-disabled dashboard switcher mode? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §Switcher Evidence]

## Dashboard Evidence

- [ ] CHK013 Are dashboard Metric Cards, Task Flow, Task Pipeline, and triage totals required only when dashboard behavior or tests change? [Scope Control, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §Dashboard Evidence]

## Smoke Evidence Envelope

- [ ] CHK016 Are every required `spec-010b.smoke_evidence.v1` top-level field and phase listed with status, timestamp, evidence references, and redaction-safe notes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Contract `smoke-evidence.md` §Smoke Evidence Envelope]
